title: Try the bishop alone
objective: Prepare a long diagonal for your bishop in a different position.

commentary_source.name: Uroschess original independent practice
commentary_source.attribution: Original teaching text and distinct synthetic Catalan-style position

steps.explanation: This board is different. Your bishop still needs a useful job.
steps.detail: Your knight on f3 blocks the long view for now. Moving it later can open the diagonal. Try without glowing piece hints.
steps.coach_prompt: Find a home for your bishop behind the moved g-pawn.

question.prompt: Where can your bishop prepare to use a long diagonal?
hints: The g-pawn has already made a doorway.
Move the bishop from f1 to g2.

tree.feedback: Bg2 puts the bishop behind your moved g-pawn. Your knight on f3 blocks its view now; moving the knight later can open the diagonal.
Bh3 develops the bishop, but it misses the space behind your moved g-pawn. Try another home.

question.other_legal_move_text: That legal move may be useful. Return and choose a home for the bishop.

takeaway: A bishop can prepare a long diagonal before the path is fully open.
